title: How are the secondhand breeks
html_source:
“Breeks” are pants or breeches.

Stephen, being perpetually broke (TLC would later use the word “scrub” to refer to men like him) must wear Mulligan’s old hand-me-downs. Later, it is also mentioned that Stephen is in debt to Mulligan, as well as other people.
